name: Archiv
tagline: Smart document scanner with tagging and fast search.
blurb: Archiv is an Android app for managing and scanning documents, featuring fast search, tagging, and local processing for maximum privacy.
description:
Archiv is an Android app for managing and scanning documents, featuring fast search, tagging, and local processing for maximum privacy.

Features

• High-Quality Scanning: Capture documents with precision and ML-powered corner detection.

• Document Management: Organize your scanned documents with a powerful tagging system and fast search.

• PDF Generation: Convert your scans into high-quality PDF files.

• Privacy First: All processing and storage happen locally on your device.

• Multi-language Support: Available in English and Hindi.

• Modern UI: Built with Jetpack Compose for a smooth and responsive experience.

Everything is processed on-device, and your documents never leave your phone. Open-source and privacy-focused.
